description: Takes the user's contract list (one row per contract) and returns, sorted by urgency: notice deadlines within the window (default 90 days, under 14 days flagged as urgent), contracts whose deadline was missed and that renew silently with the next possible notice date, contracts that end by themselves, gaps in the list (no end date, no notice period, no renewal rule), contracts without an owner and the annual value at stake. Per contract: name, supplier, start or end, initial term, renewal (months or yes/no), notice period (e.g. 3 months, 6 weeks, 30 days), owner, annual value, status (cancelled). German or English column names are recognised (Vertrag, Lieferant, Beginn, Ende, Laufzeit, Verlängerung, Kündigungsfrist, Verantwortlich, Jahreswert). The deadline is the last day notice must reach the other party, calculated as in calculate_notice_deadline. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

contracts.description: Contract rows: name, supplier, start (date), end (date), initial_term_months, renewal_months (or auto_renewal yes/no, yes = 12 months), notice (e.g. '3 months', '6 weeks', '3m'), owner, annual_value, status. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

window_days.description: Days ahead that count as due. Default 90.

name: check_contracts
title: Check a whole contract list: notice deadlines in the next days, silent renewals, missed deadlines, contracts without an owner
